kp_merged_into_ck.name: kp_merged_into_ck
kp_merged_into_ck.value: status <> 'merged' OR merged_into IS NOT NULL

question_prov_scan_ck.name: question_prov_scan_ck
question_prov_scan_ck.value: prov_type != 'scan'     OR (source_doc_id IS NOT NULL AND source_page_no IS NOT NULL)

question_prov_model_ck.name: question_prov_model_ck
question_prov_model_ck.value: prov_type != 'model'    OR model_id IS NOT NULL

question_prov_pipeline_ck.name: question_prov_pipeline_ck
question_prov_pipeline_ck.value: prov_type != 'pipeline' OR pipeline_ref IS NOT NULL

question_prov_manual_ck.name: question_prov_manual_ck
question_prov_manual_ck.value: prov_type != 'manual'   OR created_by IS NOT NULL

source_doc_kind_ck.name: source_doc_kind_ck
source_doc_kind_ck.value: kind IN ('册子','群卷','试卷','讲义','其他')

sku_type_ck.name: sku_type_ck
sku_type_ck.value: type IN ('打卡','专项','合刊','讲义','练习册','卷')

review_queue_kind_ck.name: review_queue_kind_ck
review_queue_kind_ck.value: kind IN ('kp低置信','图片','KG提议','模型转正','新题草稿','隔离','抽查','其他')
